declarada.citacao: p.8, sec. 4.1 Background Information of the Hospital Building: 'The construction stage, operational stage, and demolition stage are estimated to occupy 2, 50, and 0.5 years, respectively.'; p.9: 'Multiplied by the 50-year operational stage, the carbon emissions generated in the operation stage are 36,600 tCO2-eq.'

aplicacao_citacao: p.8, sec. 4.1: 'This hospital is a public building with a reinforced concrete frame structure system. The gross floor area (GFA) is 6367 m2 ... The four-storey building of 15.9 m has 102 beds'
nota: Valor gravado (50 anos) confirmado. Os 50 anos sao a duracao estimada da fase de operacao do edificio, sem norma nem estudo citado; aplica-se ao edificio inteiro (pares C20 e C30).

aplicacao_citacao: sec. 2.2 Materials: misturas modeladas a partir dos dados de Meddah et al. (117 misturas, 28 d) com a ferramenta de dosagem; 'We note, not all mixtures considered may not be applicable for all applications ... Additional selection criteria would need to be applied based on specific project needs.'
nota: Estudo de dosagem/modelacao cradle-to-gate (GWP100); nenhuma vida util mencionada. A introducao so refere 'elongating in-use life [11]' como estrategia de eficiencia material, sem valor.

aplicacao_citacao: p.12 'Anatomy of a T-Wall': 'the concrete barriers used by the United States military in theatres of war ... are precast in 2.5 m lengths for installation in location and must meet a minimum compressive strength of 20 MPa'; p.13: 'reinforced pre-cast concrete required for construction of the ~412 km of concrete walls installed in Baghdad during the occupation'
nota: Muros de protecao balistica (T-walls/Texas barriers) pre-fabricados, barreiras militares de seguranca/segregacao em Bagdade; classificados como infraestrutura (barreira/contencao), nao sao elemento corrente de edificio. Ambito so producao do cimento e betao armado pre-fabricado; nenhuma vida util declarada nem citada.

aplicacao_citacao: Resumo (p.1): 'cradle-to-gate life cycle assessment (LCA), the study analyses the environmental impact of constructing a seven-story archetype residential building in' Quito; paredes resistentes (shear walls) de betao celular leve armado
nota: LCA cradle-to-gate sem fase de uso; a discussao so refere preocupacoes com a durabilidade a longo prazo do CLC (Narayanan e Ramamurthy [13]) sem valor de vida util.

aplicacao_citacao: sec. 2.1 Scope and System Limits (p.2): 'Five concrete mixes were produced with a water/cement ratio (w/c) of 0.5 and other five mixes with a w/c of 0.7 ... replacement rates of virgin coarse aggregate by recycled coarse aggregate'; FU = producao de 1 m3 de betao (p.3)
nota: Estudo de laboratorio (6 paginas, lido na integra); nenhuma vida util. Valores fck dos pares conferem com a Tabela 4.

aplicacao_citacao: sec. 3.3.1 Scope and Functional Unit: 'The functional unit through the study is one cubic meter of high-strength concrete normalized with respect to its 28-day compressive strength'; misturas de Wu et al. [31] para 'high-strength concrete applications in Singapore', sem elemento/estrutura definido
nota: Cradle-to-gate; a unica mencao e generica na introducao ('low maintenance requirements during the service life of the structures'), sem valor.

aplicacao_citacao: sec. 2.2.3: 'a live load of 2.4 kPa was considered for commercial occupancy'; 'the commercial buildings were assumed to be located in Vancouver, Canada' (pavimentos mistos madeira-betao TCC de edificios)
nota: Carbono incorporado cradle-to-gate (Athena IE) por m2 de laje; nenhuma vida util declarada nem citada.

declarada.citacao: p.3, sec. 2.1 Goal and Scope, pressupostos: '(1) The life cycle length of the system is 50years. The lifespan is the same as the lifespan assumed in previous works on a Chinese subway [22] and a light rail case [33].'; sec. 3.2.3: 'If the life cycle is considered to be 50 years long, the total carbon emission is calculated to be 60.51 t.'

aplicacao_citacao: Tabelas de construcao (sec. 3.2): processos divididos em 'Bridge substructure' (estacas, pilares) e 'Bridge superstructure' (vigas) do troco elevado da linha 2 do monocarril de Chongqing; manutencao segundo a 'Budget Norm of Maintenance and Strengthening of Highway Bridges (YNG/T B02-2011)'
nota: Valor gravado (50 anos) confirmado; base passa a 'literatura' (refs. [22] metro de Xangai e [33] metro ligeiro), nao norma. A Tabela 1 (revisao) lista vidas uteis de outros sistemas ferroviarios (50, 60, 100 anos HSR), nao do sistema estudado. Aplicacao: viaduto/via elevada de transporte ferroviario (o artigo chama-lhe 'bridge'); pode tambem ler-se como infraestrutura de transporte.

aplicacao_citacao: sec. 2.2/4.2: sectores IO '100% OPC 50 MPa concrete' e '90% FA/10% GGBFS Geopolymer 50 MPa concrete' com as misturas de 1 m3 de Teh et al. (2017); resultados cradle-to-gate por unidade de material
nota: Metodo MU-hLCA a escala da economia australiana; nenhuma vida util. Menciona usos correntes do RCA (sub-base rodoviaria, betoes nao estruturais) apenas como contexto, nao como aplicacao do betao estudado.

aplicacao_citacao: sec. 3 Application (p.10-11): caso de estudo OPC vs GPC 50 MPa com RCA; 'Results refer to the functional unit of 1 m3 of concrete.'
nota: Nota tecnica de decomposicao de inventarios hibridos (15 p., lida na integra); nenhuma vida util nem aplicacao.
